title: Dynamics of self-maps in their primal topologies
summary: We study a series of dynamical concepts for self-maps in the primal topology induced by them. Among the concepts studied are non-wandering points, limit points, recurrent points, minimal sets, transitive points and self-maps, topologically ergodic self-maps, weakly mixing self-maps, strongly mixing self-maps, Lyapunov stable self-maps, chaotic self-maps in the sense of Auslander-Yorke, chaotic self-maps in the sense of Devaney, asymptotic pairs, proximal pairs, and syndetically proximal pairs.
